name: cloud-engineering-connector
description: Cloud-hosted MCP connector v0.2.0 — configurable allowlist; worker built deterministically from main 0.1.0 baseline + scripts/apply-v0.2-allowlist.mjs (see docs/BUILD_AND_PROVENANCE.md).

scripts.build: node scripts/apply-v0.2-allowlist.mjs ${BASE_WORKER_PATH:?set BASE_WORKER_PATH to a 0.1.0 worker.js}
scripts.check: node --check worker.js && node --check lib/allowlist.js && node --check test/allowlist.test.js && node --check test/credential-matrix.test.js
